tools.name: carry_opportunities_ui
tools.description: Fetch the existing paid /carry/opportunities result and render one read-only opportunity. The upstream HTTP 402 challenge is the price and entitlement source of truth; no data is returned before authorization.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "carry_opportunities_ui" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
